page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin, one note beside the lines "Agrarii ordines" to "runt"; at the foot right, the catchword. Running head at top: "Deque Vrbe Groninga", page number 179 at top right.

main_text.l: Quæ ut intelligi possit, quæ partium po-
rent remp. divisam à civitate, nec quic-
quam cum hac haberent commune, præ-
civitate,in iis de rep. consultare & statue-
judices summos exse edere volebant: jus
fori rerum venalium in oppido,&id quod

page.notes: Catchword "& quæ:" is at the foot right and is taken as the catchword; the final mark may be a colon or a stop. "contra,con" / "junctionem": no hyphen is printed at the line end, so the word is written whole as conjunctionem. "mittoCivitas" is printed without a space. "infti-" is read as insti-tutam but is doubtful. "exse" is printed with long s. The paragraph is one continuous paragraph across the page; no indented line starts a new one. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is left out.
